metadata.title: Sunitinib 37.5 mg Therapy – 28 day
metadata.indication: Unresectable or metastatic, well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour with disease progression in an adult.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Continuous daily treatment until progression or unacceptable toxicity

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00327 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Unresectable or metastatic, well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour with disease progression in an adult.

treatment.schedule_summary: Sunitinib 37.5 mg orally once daily continuously
treatment.duration_text: Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.label: Hand-foot syndrome grade
hand_foot_syndrome_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess painful erythema, swelling, blistering and limitation of instrumental or self-care activities.
